onlyOwner setter that updates the baseURI state variable
onlyOwner function that flips isSaleActive boolean
onlyOwner function that mints reserved tokens using a pseudo-random seed derived from index, msg.sender and block.timestamp
Payable public mint function enforcing sale state, per-wallet limit and exact ETH payment, then mints tokens via keccak-based randomness
Private function that selects a unique token id from the ids array using modulo arithmetic and swap-removal logic
onlyOwner function that splits the contract balance and transfers shares to three hardcoded addresses
Public function that burns a token after checking caller is owner or approved
Returns the metadata URI built from baseURI and the token id
Private string holding the collection metadata base URI
Public boolean controlling whether minting is enabled
Public counter of all minted tokens including reserved
Public counter of reserved tokens minted via reserveTokens
Public per-token mint price (0.111 ether)
Fixed-size uint256[4900] array used as the unique id pool for the swap-removal selection
Private counter tracking how many ids have been consumed
Mapping tracking how many tokens each address has minted
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller address
block.timestamp, the miner-influenceable timestamp used as randomness entropy
_safeMint performs an external callback to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient contract, enabling reentrancy
payable(...).transfer(balance/...) sends ETH to hardcoded addresses in withdraw
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(index, msg.sender, block.timestamp)) used as on-chain pseudo-randomness, weak and timestamp-dependent
Arithmetic inside _pickRandomUniqueId: ids[randomIndex] + 1, len - 1 and id + 1 computations with cast to uint16
amount parameter of mint (number of tokens requested)
random parameter passed into _pickRandomUniqueId
local variable len = ids.length - index++ inside _pickRandomUniqueId
local variable randomIndex = random % len inside _pickRandomUniqueId
local variable balance = address(this).balance in withdraw
local _random value derived from keccak256 of index, msg.sender and block.timestamp in mint/reserveTokens

edges.reason: block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 pseudo-random seed, making minting outcome timestamp dependent and miner manipulable
msg.sender is part of the keccak256 randomness seed
The keccak hash result is assigned to the local _random seed
_random is passed as the random argument into _pickRandomUniqueId
_pickRandomUniqueId performs id = ids[randomIndex] + 1 and len-1 arithmetic that determines the returned token id
_safeMint calls back into the recipient (msg.sender) during mint before state updates are fully settled, allowing reentrancy into mint
_safeMint in reserveTokens triggers an external callback to the receiver contract
mint invokes _safeMint for each requested token
reserveTokens invokes _safeMint for each reserved token
msg.sender determines the addressToNumMinted per-wallet limit check and the mint recipient
mint reads isSaleActive to gate execution
mint increments totalMinted without a MAX_SUPPLY check
mint increments addressToNumMinted[msg.sender]
amount parameter drives amount*price and per-wallet limit arithmetic in mint
reserveTokens increments totalReserved after bounded checks
reserveTokens increments totalMinted within MAX_SUPPLY check
withdraw performs three payable transfers of the computed balance shares
balance is read from address(this).balance and split with balance/100*... arithmetic in withdraw
withdraw is restricted by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender()
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable
toggleSaleState flips the isSaleActive state variable
constructor initializes baseURI to the metadata endpoint
ids array is read mutated by _pickRandomUniqueId swap-removal selection
index++ is consumed in len = ids.length - index++ inside _pickRandomUniqueId
random parameter is reduced to randomIndex = random % len
len local is the modulus used to compute randomIndex
randomIndex indexes ids[] in the unchecked id derivation arithmetic
tokenURI reads baseURI to build the metadata URI

normalization_plan.reason: amount is only meaningful as the loop bound and price arithmetic input of mint
random is only consumed inside _pickRandomUniqueId to derive randomIndex
len is a temporary length value used solely in _pickRandomUniqueId arithmetic
randomIndex is a temporary index used only for the ids[] lookup in _pickRandomUniqueId
balance is a temporary read of address(this).balance used only by the withdraw transfers
_random is the keccak-derived seed produced and immediately consumed inside the mint loop
